title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Acts 1: the promise of the Holy Spirit, Jesus taken up into the sky, and Matthias chosen by lot.

questions.text: To whom is this book addressed?
questions.explanation: The writer says the first book he wrote was for Theophilus, about all that Jesus began to do and to teach.

questions.text: Over what period did Jesus appear to them after he suffered?
questions.explanation: He showed himself alive by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God's Kingdom.

questions.text: What did Jesus command them while he was assembled with them?
questions.explanation: He commanded them not to depart from Jerusalem, but to wait for the promise of the Father which they had heard from him.

answers.text: To go at once to Samaria
To draw lots for a twelfth apostle
To stay in Jerusalem and wait for the promise
To be baptized in water again

questions.text: Where did Jesus say they would be his witnesses?
questions.explanation: He said they would be witnesses to him in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.

answers.text: In Galilee and in Judea only
In Jerusalem, Judea, Samaria and the uttermost parts of the earth

questions.text: What received Jesus out of their sight when he was taken up?
questions.explanation: As they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

questions.text: What did the two men in white clothing tell the men of Galilee?
questions.explanation: They said that this Jesus, who was received up into the sky, would come back in the same way as they saw him going.

answers.text: That he would restore the kingdom at once
That he would come back the same way
That they should go home to Galilee
That they would never see him again

questions.text: From which mountain did they return to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: They returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day's journey away.

questions.text: About how many names were there when Peter stood up among the disciples?
questions.explanation: Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples, and the number of names was about one hundred twenty.

questions.text: What was the field called in the language of those living in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: It became known to everyone in Jerusalem that in their language the field was called Akeldama, that is, The field of blood.

questions.text: On whom did the lot fall when two men were put forward?
questions.explanation: They drew lots for them, the lot fell on Matthias, and he was counted with the eleven apostles.
